demo_scenario_runs_purge_consistent.name: demo_scenario_runs_purge_consistent
demo_scenario_runs_purge_consistent.value: ("demo_scenario_runs"."status" = 'purged' and "demo_scenario_runs"."purged_at" is not null) or ("demo_scenario_runs"."status" = 'active' and "demo_scenario_runs"."purged_at" is null)

guidance_progress_completed_consistent.name: guidance_progress_completed_consistent
guidance_progress_completed_consistent.value: ("guidance_progress"."state" = 'completed' and "guidance_progress"."completed_at" is not null) or ("guidance_progress"."state" <> 'completed' and "guidance_progress"."completed_at" is null)

guidance_progress_dismissed_consistent.name: guidance_progress_dismissed_consistent
guidance_progress_dismissed_consistent.value: ("guidance_progress"."state" = 'dismissed' and "guidance_progress"."dismissed_at" is not null) or ("guidance_progress"."state" <> 'dismissed' and "guidance_progress"."dismissed_at" is null)

opening_hours_times_present.name: opening_hours_times_present
opening_hours_times_present.value:
case when "opening_hours"."closed" then "opening_hours"."opens" is null and "opening_hours"."closes" is null
           else "opening_hours"."opens" is not null and "opening_hours"."closes" is not null end

service_areas_shape.name: service_areas_shape
service_areas_shape.value:
case "service_areas"."kind"
            when 'radius' then "service_areas"."center_latitude" is not null and "service_areas"."center_longitude" is not null and "service_areas"."radius_km" is not null
            when 'regions' then array_length("service_areas"."regions", 1) is not null
            else false
          end

mail_senders_connection_consistent.name: mail_senders_connection_consistent
mail_senders_connection_consistent.value: ("mail_senders"."provider" in ('gmail', 'outlook') and "mail_senders"."connected_account_id" is not null) or ("mail_senders"."provider" not in ('gmail', 'outlook') and "mail_senders"."connected_account_id" is null)

mail_suppressions_release_consistent.name: mail_suppressions_release_consistent
mail_suppressions_release_consistent.value: ("mail_suppressions"."active" = true and "mail_suppressions"."released_at" is null) or ("mail_suppressions"."active" = false and "mail_suppressions"."released_at" is not null)

assets_trash_dates_consistent.name: assets_trash_dates_consistent
assets_trash_dates_consistent.value: ("assets"."status" = 'trashed' and "assets"."deleted_at" is not null and "assets"."purge_after" is not null) or ("assets"."status" <> 'trashed' and "assets"."deleted_at" is null and "assets"."purge_after" is null)

media_alt_text_review_consistent.name: media_alt_text_review_consistent
media_alt_text_review_consistent.value: ("media_alt_text_suggestions"."status" = 'ready' and "media_alt_text_suggestions"."reviewed_by" is null and "media_alt_text_suggestions"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("media_alt_text_suggestions"."status" <> 'ready' and "media_alt_text_suggestions"."reviewed_by" is not null and "media_alt_text_suggestions"."reviewed_at" is not null)

notification_deliveries_digest_consisten.name: notification_deliveries_digest_consistent
notification_deliveries_digest_consisten.value: ("notification_deliveries"."kind" = 'digest' and "notification_deliveries"."status" in ('deferred', 'processing', 'delivered', 'skipped', 'failed')) or ("notification_deliveries"."kind" <> 'digest' and "notification_deliveries"."digest_id" is null)

notifications_escalation_consistent.name: notifications_escalation_consistent
notifications_escalation_consistent.value: "notifications"."escalated_at" is null or "notifications"."escalate_at" is not null

consent_records_purpose_channel.name: consent_records_purpose_channel
consent_records_purpose_channel.value:
("consent_records"."purpose" = 'marketing' and "consent_records"."channel" in ('email', 'sms', 'push'))
        or ("consent_records"."purpose" = 'analytics' and "consent_records"."channel" = 'web')
        or ("consent_records"."purpose" = 'data_processing' and "consent_records"."channel" is null)

data_requests_verified_state.name: data_requests_verified_state
data_requests_verified_state.value: "data_requests"."status" not in ('verified', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'partially_completed') or "data_requests"."verified_at" is not null

data_requests_fulfilled_state.name: data_requests_fulfilled_state
data_requests_fulfilled_state.value: "data_requests"."status" not in ('completed', 'partially_completed', 'denied') or "data_requests"."fulfilled_at" is not null

builder_proposals_lifecycle_valid.name: builder_proposals_lifecycle_valid
builder_proposals_lifecycle_valid.value: ("builder_proposals"."status" <> 'applied' or "builder_proposals"."applied_at" is not null) and ("builder_proposals"."status" <> 'rolled_back' or ("builder_proposals"."applied_at" is not null and "builder_proposals"."rolled_back_at" is not null))

product_lifecycle_events_visibility_vali.name: product_lifecycle_events_visibility_valid
product_lifecycle_events_visibility_vali.value:
("product_lifecycle_events"."from_visibility" is null or "product_lifecycle_events"."from_visibility" in ('public','unlisted','member_only'))
        and "product_lifecycle_events"."to_visibility" in ('public','unlisted','member_only')

products_lifecycle_timestamps.name: products_lifecycle_timestamps
products_lifecycle_timestamps.value:
("products"."status" = 'active' and "products"."published_at" is not null and "products"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("products"."status" = 'draft' and "products"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("products"."status" = 'archived' and "products"."archived_at" is not null)

credit_notes_issued_consistent.name: credit_notes_issued_consistent
credit_notes_issued_consistent.value: ("credit_notes"."status" = 'draft' and "credit_notes"."number" is null and "credit_notes"."issued_at" is null) or ("credit_notes"."status" <> 'draft' and "credit_notes"."number" is not null and "credit_notes"."issued_at" is not null)

invoices_amounts_nonnegative.name: invoices_amounts_nonnegative
invoices_amounts_nonnegative.value: "invoices"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."discount_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."shipping_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."tax_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."total_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."paid_minor" >= 0 and "invoices"."refunded_minor" >= 0

invoices_issued_consistent.name: invoices_issued_consistent
invoices_issued_consistent.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null) or ("invoices"."status" <> 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)

late_fee_assessments_value_valid.name: late_fee_assessments_value_valid
late_fee_assessments_value_valid.value: ("late_fee_assessments"."basis" = 'fixed' and "late_fee_assessments"."fixed_minor" > 0 and "late_fee_assessments"."rate_ppm" is null) or ("late_fee_assessments"."basis" = 'percentage' and "late_fee_assessments"."fixed_minor" is null and "late_fee_assessments"."rate_ppm" between 1 and 10000000)

payment_disputes_closed_consistent.name: payment_disputes_closed_consistent
payment_disputes_closed_consistent.value: ("payment_disputes"."status" = 'open' and "payment_disputes"."closed_at" is null) or ("payment_disputes"."status" <> 'open' and "payment_disputes"."closed_at" is not null)

payment_methods_expiry_pair.name: payment_methods_expiry_pair
payment_methods_expiry_pair.value: ("payment_methods"."expiry_month" is null and "payment_methods"."expiry_year" is null) or ("payment_methods"."expiry_month" between 1 and 12 and "payment_methods"."expiry_year" between 2000 and 9999)

payments_success_consistent.name: payments_success_consistent
payments_success_consistent.value: "payments"."status" <> 'succeeded' or ("payments"."provider_ref" is not null and "payments"."processed_at" is not null)

refunds_success_consistent.name: refunds_success_consistent
refunds_success_consistent.value: "refunds"."status" <> 'succeeded' or ("refunds"."provider_ref" is not null and "refunds"."processed_at" is not null)

tax_exemptions_window_valid.name: tax_exemptions_window_valid
tax_exemptions_window_valid.value: "tax_exemptions"."validated_at" is null or "tax_exemptions"."expires_at" is null or "tax_exemptions"."expires_at" > "tax_exemptions"."validated_at"

tax_lines_item_pointer.name: tax_lines_item_pointer
tax_lines_item_pointer.value: ("tax_lines"."kind" = 'item' and "tax_lines"."invoice_line_id" is not null) or ("tax_lines"."kind" = 'shipping' and "tax_lines"."invoice_line_id" is null) or "tax_lines"."kind" = 'exemption'

tax_rates_effective_window_valid.name: tax_rates_effective_window_valid
tax_rates_effective_window_valid.value: "tax_rates"."effective_from" is null or "tax_rates"."effective_to" is null or "tax_rates"."effective_to" >= "tax_rates"."effective_from"

tax_registrations_threshold_currency_val.name: tax_registrations_threshold_currency_valid
tax_registrations_threshold_currency_val.value: ("tax_registrations"."threshold_minor" = 0 and ("tax_registrations"."threshold_currency" is null or "tax_registrations"."threshold_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')) or ("tax_registrations"."threshold_minor" > 0 and "tax_registrations"."threshold_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

tax_zones_template_pair.name: tax_zones_template_pair
tax_zones_template_pair.value: ("tax_zones"."template_key" is null and "tax_zones"."template_version" is null) or ("tax_zones"."template_key" is not null and "tax_zones"."template_version" > 0)
